title: Outlook: remember whether the online archive is expanded or collapsed in the folder pane
summary: The briefing accurately reports the planned display change and distinguishes it from existing archive administration. The licensing, archive-enablement control and deletion warning are supported; the help-desk checklist could give the full route to the archive setting.

claims.where: controls[1]; summary; Why it matters; Governance controls
claims.claim: No tenant or policy switch for remembering online-archive expansion state is documented on the admin UI or automation surface.
claims.quote: Searched: Outlook online archive folder pane remember state admin policy PowerShell Exchange disable. Opened Set-OwaMailboxPolicy, policy-management and policy mapping; searched the cmdlet text for remember, collaps, expanded and FolderPane; no remembered-state control.

claims.claim: Set-OwaMailboxPolicy has a ShowOnlineArchiveEnabled parameter.
claims.quote: ### -ShowOnlineArchiveEnabled

claims.claim: ShowOnlineArchiveEnabled is available only in Exchange Online.
claims.quote:
### -ShowOnlineArchiveEnabled

> Applicable: Exchange Online

This parameter is available only in the cloud-based service.

claims.claim: The classic-to-new Outlook policy mapping points to ShowOnlineArchiveEnabled for mailbox archive settings.
claims.quote: Configures mailbox archive settings. | Use the Set-OwaMailboxPolicy cmdlet together with the ShowOnlineArchiveEnabled parameter.

claims.claim: The parameter reference provides no description of what ShowOnlineArchiveEnabled does.
claims.quote: Searched: ShowOnlineArchiveEnabled in the fetched Set-OwaMailboxPolicy reference. Its section says 'This parameter is available only in the cloud-based service.' followed by '{{ Fill ShowOnlineArchiveEnabled Description }}', then parameter properties.

claims.claim: Most mailbox policies apply to both Outlook on the web and new Outlook for Windows.
claims.quote: Most of the mailbox policies apply to both Outlook on the web and new Outlook for Windows

claims.claim: Those shared mailbox policies cannot be enabled on one of the two clients but not the other.
claims.quote: Most of the mailbox policies apply to both Outlook on the web and new Outlook for Windows, so you can't enable them on one client but not the other.

claims.claim: After an archive is disabled, its original contents are permanently deleted after 30 days.
claims.quote: After 30 days, the contents of the original archive mailbox are permanently deleted and can't be recovered.
